title: Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated
text:
Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated

['From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Moore <jenna@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated

Hi Jenna,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our discussion I put together a concise activation itinerary for the hosted→dedicated transition so your SRE and procurement teams can review. The key asks from Redwood are:
- Finalize expected p95 latency SLO and throughput targets per API route (I added our recommended headroom in the attached sizing matrix).
- Choose the phased activation window (we propose 3 sequential shards over three business days to limit blast radius).
- Confirm test traffic slice and a signed mutual action plan (Dev→Prod smoke, canary, full cut).

Attachments: nimbus_sizing_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

High-level acceptance criteria we’ll run during each phase:
- Throughput sanity: sustained token ingestion matching 1.2x expected peak for 30m.
- Latency p95 <= requested SLO for both short-chat and long-seq endpoints.
- KV cache hit-rate baseline within 90% of hosted behavior for cached prompt sets.
- Fallback verification: automatic routing to hosted model variant if any lane exceeds error thresholds.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Phase A (warmup + smoke): Day 1, 02:00–06:00
- Phase B (canary ramp): Day 2, 02:00–08:00
- Phase C (full switch): Day 3, 00:00–04:00

Please confirm whether those windows work for your on-call SRE and procurement timelines. If we get a green light, I’ll schedule a brief dry-run with your engineers and hand off the cutover runbook to Karthik for ops sequencing.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated

Dylan — thanks for the summary and the sizing matrix. Quick notes from infra/team POV:

1) Sizing observations (per the spreadsheet):
- For the long-sequence endpoint, recommend starting with 8 A100-equivalent GPUs (bfloat16 quant path) across 2 pods for Phase A; move to 16 for Phase B and 24 for Phase C, assuming 1.2x peak.
- Suggest enabling KV-prefetch and a 4k token window in staging to match production profiles — will reduce p95 drift.

2) Test plan specifics we should include in the runbook:
- Ramp profile: 0→25% over 15m, hold 20m, 25→60% over 30m, then revert to 10% traffic for 10m.
- Failure conditions: >5% 5xxs OR p95 > 2x SLO for 10m triggers rollback.

3) Ops staffing: need at least one Redwood infra engineer and one Nimbus SRE overlap for each activation window.

I’m attaching a shortcut checklist I’ll use during the dry-run. Adding Marissa to own billing/commit confirmation and Karthik for the cutover run sequence.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Jenna Moore <jenna@nimbushealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com, ops-team@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 14:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated

Thanks, Dylan and Neha — this is helpful. A couple quick items from Nimbus:

- Windows: Day 1 and Day 2 look fine; Day 3 full switch needs to be on a Sunday to align with our deployment blackout. Can we do Phase C on Sun Jan 3, 2027 00:00–04:00 PST?
- Procurement: attached procurement_instructions.pdf with our PO routing and required billing contact. Procurement asked for a single point of contact at Redwood for the PO and contract signature.
- Compliance: our security team wants a short list of logs/retention (audit, request traces) so they can update their SOC evidence pack before cut.

We confirm we’ll have one on-call SRE (me) for Phases A and B and two engineers for Phase C.

Attachments: procurement_instructions.pdf (pdf)

—Jenna Moore
Director of Platform Engineering, Nimbus Health
', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Moore <jenna@nimbushealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated

Jenna / team — thanks for the note. I drafted a compact cutover run sequence below and attached a versioned runbook for your ops team to review. Key points:

Cutover run sequence (abbreviated):
1) Pre-cut verification (T-48h): confirm PO routing, infra seats are provisioned, and all secrets/keys are in place.
2) Dry-run (T-24h): replay 30m of synthetic traffic at 0.6x peak on staging with KV cache priming.
3) Phase A (warmup): warm GPUs, run 1h smoke with 0→25% traffic ramp, validate cache hit rate and p95.
4) Phase B (canary): increment to 60% traffic slice with auto-fallback enabled; monitor for 45m.
5) Phase C (full): change routing to dedicated; keep hosted fallback in warm standby for 2h.

Rollback & safety nets:
- Automatic rollback trigger if error budget breached (as specified by Neha).
- Maintain a small mirrored connection to hosted API for any request requiring immediate fallback.
- Post-switch: 24h elevated support window and 7-day monitoring cadence.

Owners and contacts:
- Redwood infra lead: Neha Kapoor (primary)
- Redwood ops sequencing: Karthik Iyer (run owner) — I’ll handle step execution and final go/no-go.
- Billing/commercial: Marissa Cole (owns PO and contract confirmation)
- Nimbus on-call: Jenna Moore (primary)

Attachments: cutover-runbook-v1.md (markdown)

Please review the runbook link below and confirm the Sunday full switch. I’ll prepare the DocuSign envelope for the mutual action plan once Marissa gives procurement the green light.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Moore <jenna@nimbushealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orchestration phasing & activation itinerary — hosted → dedicated

All — sounds good. Confirming the updated high-level schedule:
- Dry-run (staging): Fri Jan 1, 2027 02:00–03:00 PST (Neha + Nimbus SRE)
- Phase A (warmup): Sat Jan 2, 2027 02:00–06:00 PST
- Phase B (canary): Sat Jan 2, 2027 22:00–23:59 PST
- Phase C (full switch): Sun Jan 3, 2027 00:00–04:00 PST (final)

Marissa — please confirm when procurement will cut the PO and I’ll attach DocuSign for the mutual action plan. Karthik, please publish cutover-runbook-v1 to the shared ops doc and tag the on-call sequence in the header.

We’ll keep this thread for any follow-ups. If anyone prefers a short call to finalize owners, I can set a 30m slot tomorrow.

Thanks — and happy holidays to everyone.

Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
